title: How AI is making music producers obsolete

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI can now compose, mix, and master tracks in minutes—threatening the role of human producers. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AI lacks the emotional depth and creative intuition that make music resonate with listeners. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But AI tools like Splice and LANDR are already used by professionals for fast, high-quality output. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: No algorithm can replicate the human touch—genre shifts, nuance, and cultural context are beyond AI. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Human producers will adapt, but AI will never replace the soul in music. (4 sec)
